before.name: Robert Held
before.description: Robert Held, a Flossmoor, Illinois resident, attended the September 27, 2025 protest outside the Broadview immigration detention facility to oppose ICE enforcement tactics and observe the treatment of protesters. In a signed declaration, he described being sprayed with a chemical agent earlier in the afternoon, receiving help from other protesters, and returning to the demonstration. Later, he said he tried to move away as federal agents ordered people out of the road, but agents pursued him, handcuffed him and drove him into the facility. He was questioned, fingerprinted and photographed, then held with other arrested protesters. He reported release around 1:30 a.m. on September 28 without charges. The November 20, 2025 opinion in Chicago Headline Club v. Noem discusses his account. Robert Held is a separate person from Stephen “Steve” Held, the journalist detained that evening.

credit: CBS Chicago; interview report by Sabrina Franza; camera operator unnamed

identity_verification: CBS October 2 2025 interview identifies 68-year-old Chicago attorney Robert Held detained at Broadview September 27 without charges. Signed MacArthur Justice declaration independently confirms name, age, Held Law Offices, arrest date and overnight release. Single interview subject visible unmasked; distinct from journalist Stephen Held and Canadian glass artist Robert Held.
